Footballer Erling Haaland's viral video identified as AI-generated

A video showing footballer Erling Haaland reacting to his reflection has gained viral attention. Multiple reports have identified the video as being artificially generated using AI. The footage has circulated widely online, sparking discussion about the spread of AI-created content.
